title: Software Engineer
text:
Timothy Altemus
832-359-7707 | hello@timothyaltemus.com 
linkedin/timothyaltemus | github/timsexperiments | timsexperiments.foo
Ask Tim's MCP about my experience: timsexperiments.foo/resume/mcp
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer | R1 RCM - Agent Dispatch	Feb 2026 - present
Designed and implemented a configurable dispatch platform handling approximately 2 million accounts weekly, expanding first-touch routing to reevaluate accounts as data changes.
Built an explainable criteria engine and healthcare-specific agent controls, enabling domain teams to build their own dispatch modules; now lead the Agent Dispatch engineering team.
Designed and led delivery of a Slack support agent resolving 71% of support conversations without an engineer response, with shared tools and infrastructure also used by a general R1 support bot.
Software Engineer | Included Health - Practitioner Platform & Workflow Automation, Austin, TX	Sep 2024 - Feb 2026
Originated a shared practitioner platform from bespoke care flows, using Temporal and configurable task requirements; led the team and implemented much of the core design.
Developed configurable task qualification and routing, reducing member wait times by 80% and giving business and clinical teams visibility into routing decisions and control over workflows.
Expanded scheduling with recurring shifts and configurable workflows, driving over 1,000 additional appointment bookings per month.
Adapted scheduling APIs for an MCP server; designed practitioner data integrations, default-hidden Protobuf response masking, and extensible GraphQL profiles. The broader onboarding migration was partially delivered.
Software Engineer | Google, Austin, TX	Oct 2021 - Sep 2024
Technical Lead – Buying Experience Platform:
Integrated finance applications into the Buying Experience platform, identifying and correcting millions of dollars in errors per quarter.
Led cloud contract integration, expanding platform coverage to 100% of existing financial document use cases.
Unified Buying Experience user flows and improved microservice performance, increasing user satisfaction scores by over 30%.
Software Engineer – Supplier Central:
Launched supplier enrollment supporting multiple sites and distinct tax and banking details under one profile, expanding onboarding coverage to over 95% of Google's suppliers.
Automated banking and tax data synchronization to the data governance system, reducing synchronization time from 5 days to nearly instantaneous.
Introduced real-time supplier discussions and mentored an intern through implementation, reducing average resubmission time from 11 to 3 days.
Software Engineer | Credera, Houston, TX	 Sep 2020 – Oct 2021
Led an AI-assisted project fulfillment system combining project images, details, and professional recommendations, decreasing booking time by 70%.
Directed an event-driven architecture migration, enabling incremental replacement of legacy ATS and HRIS systems and near-real-time updates.
Software Engineer | Avanade, Seattle, WA	 May 2019 – Sep 2020
Owned test-case management and built a Selenium end-to-end suite for a Microsoft purchasing product rebuild, with Angular frontend contributions.
Contributed smaller changes to an Azure Durable Functions data pipeline. The prior resume's 11-day improvement is not established as an individually attributable result.
Built a cross-platform desktop application to validate and visualize billions of rows of data using a lazily loaded tree structure.
Areas of Expertise: Real-time Systems | Event-Driven Architecture | Software Architecture Design | Machine Learning & AI | Technical Leadership | Database & API Integration | Cross-functional Collaboration | Distributed Systems | Healthcare Systems
EDUCATION
Georgia Institute of Technology	2026
Master of Science, Computer Science, Focus in Distributed Systems and Machine Learning, GPA 3.7
University of Houston	2019
Bachelor of Business Administration, Information Systems, Minor in Computer Science, GPA 3.8
PROJECTS
Tim’s Experiments: Publish software engineering articles and develop open-source and exploratory projects with over 850,000 downloads.
Google Tech Exchange: Mentored HBCU students in computer science and software engineering, with over 75% receiving internship opportunities.
Naya Studio, the rebrand of Arumi Moves LLC: 50% owner; built the website, CRM, automated payroll, and AI-assisted operations. Also manages administrative hiring and coordinates studio contractors.
Awake Solar: Built a CRM replacing spreadsheets, an installer photo app, and Notion-based article publishing without code edits.
Texas Sports Academy: Built native device management used by over 1,000 students, fulfillment supporting about 75-200 laptop shipments weekly, and a live Zoom SDK office-hours app.
UT Health research: Owned frontend and backend development of a Flutter app for new fathers, shipped on iOS and Android with English/Spanish localization and automated releases.
SKILLS
Programming Languages: Go, TypeScript, C#, Elixir, SQL, Rust, Java, C, C++, Zig, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP, SASS, .NET, Kotlin, Groovy, Swift, Dart
Technologies & Frameworks: gRPC, Git, GraphQL, NoSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Firebase, GitHub Actions, Mercurial, Jenkins, Terraform, React, Angular, Vue, React Native, SolidJS, Astro, Spring Boot, Flask, Gin, Actix-web, Svelte, Echo, dotnet core, graph databases, Grafana, Posthog, Temporal
Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Cloudflare, Fly.io, Vercel, DigitalOcean
notes: This overview is reconciled with the interview. Detailed stories take precedence over older resume wording, particularly ownership, metrics, and delivery status.
All employer resume titles are Software Engineer. Staff/Principal describes target roles, not a claim of holding that title at every employer.
Georgia Tech lists 2026 in the supplied resume; completed versus expected status is unconfirmed. Do not assert graduation.

Figures are self-reported, not independently audited. Google satisfaction, financial-error, supplier coverage and resubmission figures, Credera booking time, open-source cumulative downloads, and Tech Exchange internship opportunities are historical resume claims; retrieve the detailed stories for limits.
Naya Studio and Arumi Moves LLC are one business. Consulting clients are anonymized by industry except Microsoft, which Tim authorized naming.
The overview does not establish availability, work authorization, compensation, relocation preferences, or confidential employer details.
description: MCP career overview reconciled with the September 2026 interview; not a byte-for-byte copy of the formatted resume.
